lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth line from the anterior, splitting toward the lower ventral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and third anterior lines terminate prematurely before reaching the ventral boundary; a truncated line segment is visible between the sixth and seventh primary lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on the lower neck/throat, two white spots on the lower cheek, and white markings on the carpal/tarsal regions of the limbs.
